# leadingedgevets

> Leading Edge Veterinary Services offers large and small animal veterinary services in Northwestern WI. Services offered include: -Wellness exams -Bull Soundness Exams (BSE) -Coggins -Vaccinations -Dental X-ray and Cleanings -Minor Surgeries -Ultrasound -X-ray in house and send out consultation -Laser Therapy -Haul-In Facilities -In House Laboratories & Send Out Tests -Online Pharmacy for Rxs -Euthanasia

- Official website: https://www.leadingedgevets.com/
- Contact: 715-934-9055 / info@leadingedgevets.com

## Services

- [Large Animal Services](https://www.leadingedgevets.com/services): -Bull Soundness Exams (BSE) -CVI (Health Certificates) - Cattle, Equine, Small Ruminants, Swine, Poultry - Haul-In Facility - After Hours Emergency for Large Animal Clients
